description:
Job Title: GIS Software Engineer (AI/ML) 
 
Job Category: Engineering 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Outside Continental US 
 
 
* * * 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 
CACI has an outstanding opportunity for a select GIS AI Software Engineer that wants to make a difference in the defense of the nation by applying their talents and experience in a fast-paced dynamic environment in support of US Special Operations Command. This opportunity is limited to self-starters with an advanced level of experience in planning, implementing, developing, and maintaining applications for a GIS Enterprise and capable of working independently in a fluid custom application development environment. You will be an integral part of a selective professional IT team that directly supports the operational planning cycle to support mission success. This position is in support of a Department of Defense (DoD) organization in Fayetteville, NC.

 Responsibilities: 
You will use advanced AI software engineering techniques to perform complex analysis, design and modification of applications and databases for GIS Enterprise. You will design and implement UI systems, integrate disparate data sources, establish API’s, and construct frameworks that enable AI/ML functions by integrating ML models into user applications and platforms.
 
 You should have excellent communication skills to include technical writing and the ability to work in a collaborative team environment. You should have the ability and willingness to continue to expand your knowledge and experience base to be detail oriented and to prioritize and complete assigned tasks within required deadlines. You should have exceptional problem solving and decision-making capabilities, including troubleshooting technical issues; successfully resolving project issues and challenges; and understanding user requirements to develop creative software solutions for process improvements.
 
 Using your knowledge and experience you will recommend innovative technologies that enhance the presentation and use of enterprise GIS products and provide integrated systems planning.

 Qualifications: 

 Required:  
 Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering and 8 years of progressive experience performing design, development, and modification of UI and applications Typically, 12 years of progressive related experience in lieu of a degree is accepted
 
 Experience with engineering UI and applications in support AI/ML strategies for the DoD/IC.
 Experienced creating and developing custom tools and distributed process for large datasets.
 Experience with/possessing a high level/expert ability to manage and work with static and dynamic streaming geospatial oriented data.
 Proficient with at least two with scripting and programming languages (HTML, JavaScript, Python, C#, C++, etc.).
 Possess strong oral and written communication skills and be capable of effectively directing subordinates.
 Required to obtain and maintain currency of the appropriate level certification in accordance with DODD 8570.01 (Security+)
 
 Desired: 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering and three additional years of general experience in the field intelligence systems architecture and geospatial systems experience
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$93,500 - $196,500 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
